title: Verwijzing naar de data van: Lay participation in the criminal justice system
descriptions: This international comparative project investigated types of lay participation, views of judges and the public as well as perspectives on function of lay judges in various European countries.
Data available in consultation with NSCR. Please contact the datamanager [datamanagement@nscr.nl]
description: This international comparative project investigated types of lay participation, views of judges and the public as well as perspectives on function of lay judges in various European countries.
keywords: Confidence in the criminal justice system
data_sources: Judges and lay judges in the Netherlands, Belgium, Germany, Denmark and England (N=66). In five countries: observations of court sessions and interviews with judges and lay judges.
